item.title: Outback road builder shares recount of enthralling adventures
item.description: Gordon Wooton, inset, has released a fascinating new book to honour the tight-knit, six-man team who opened up vital routes into the middle of nowhere. Images: Gordon Wooton Gordon Wooton was just 16 when he signed on in 1958 to join a small but resolute gang tasked with building hundreds of kilometres of outback roads into the middle of nowhere. They worked from Blanchwater to Mt Hopeless then the Cobler Sand Hills then following the Strzelecki Creek to Innamincka ending up in the Cooper Basin.

item.title: New truck sales off to sluggish start in 2026
item.description: DAF bucked the overall January trend, with deliveries like this DAF FTT XG660 from Kenworth DAF Yatala to JEM Logistics. item.description: There are new rules for refrigerated trucks at the Coolgardie rest area.
